title: S2-control bridge ref + Bugatti ref

turns.text: Make ONE photorealistic still image, widescreen 16:9, no text on it. rt3-goldengate.jpg is the PLACE; the scene must be exactly this view of the bridge. rt3-bugatti.jpg is the CAR; it must be exactly this car (shape, colour, wheels, grille), parked on the road or viewpoint in the foreground, front three-quarter view. Ignore the people and the show stand in the car photo; no people.

must_haves: The view is the Golden Gate Bridge from rt3-goldengate.jpg.
The car is the car in rt3-bugatti.jpg (shape, ice-blue colour, silver side panels, wheels, grille).
No crowd carried over; one coherent photorealistic image.
